subject: Acme POC plan, success criteria and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan King <jordan.king@acme.com>; Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood POC - discovery recap and proposed next steps

Hi Jordan / Priya

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment before we lock down the POC plan:  

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency chat and batch-embedding workflows for Acme's customer insights pipeline.
- Success signals (draft): (1) <20% regression in output quality vs your baseline on NLU eval set, (2) median token latency <150ms for 512-token context on a p95 traffic pattern, (3) end-to-end cost < $X per 1k requests (we'll confirm).
- Data: You indicated you can provide a 10k-row anonymized test set and a small live traffic replay for load testing.
- Timeline: 3-week POC (sandbox + evaluation) starting as soon as infra access is provisioned.
- Owners: Marissa (account), Marcus (technical lead), Jordan / Priya (Acme product/data).

I've attached a first-pass POC plan (redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf) with proposed milestones, evaluation criteria, and a checklist for infra access. Can you confirm:  
1) success criteria above look right or what you'd tweak,
2) who will own providing the test dataset and when, and
3) whether a 3-week window works for your team (we can adjust).

Proposed next step: Quick 30-min kickoff once we have access. I'm free Wed/Thu next week.

Thanks
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf

- For success criteria I'd add a qualitative customer-facing check: top-3 intents match within our manual labels for 90% of sampled queries.
- We'll need to confirm the cost threshold after we see quant estimates from your side.
- On data: I can own the anonymized 10k export, but we need legal to sign the access form. Priya is looped here.

We like the 3-week window but can be flexible by a week. Wed/Thu kickoff next week should work  prefer Thu morning.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood POC plan + access checklist (redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf)

Hi all forwarding the plan with more detail. Highlights from the doc (copying here for convenience):

POC scope and success criteria (final draft)
- Functional: accurate intent detection and slot extraction for your 10k test set (target: >90% top-3 intent precision).
- Latency: median per-token <150ms (p95 <350ms) on 512-token median context during replay.
- Cost: target to achieve within agreed per-1k budget; we'll produce a cost table after first run.
- Reliability: no more than 1% error rate during 1h soak test.

Evaluation plan
- Week 0 (kickoff): access + infra verification + baseline run.
- Week 1: initial runs + qualitative review + model tuning.
- Week 2: load testing + final evaluation and metrics aggregation.
- Deliverable: evaluation report + recommended config for production serving.

Owners and tasks
- Acme: provide anonymized 10k dataset (Jordan) by 2026-10-22; provide sandbox credentials (Priya).
- Redwood: run baseline, provide tuning suggestions, produce evaluation report (Marissa & Marcus).

Open items: legal/data access form, sandbox VPC peering or temporary S3 access, IAM roles. I've also added a shared Drive folder with the plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodAcmePOC  

If that looks good I'll send a calendar invite for kickoff Thu 10/21 09:00 PT.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Jordan King <jordan.king@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC plan + infra checklist

Hi Priya / Jordan  quick technical note on infra and access (copying items from the checklist):

- Preferred: S3 bucket with anonymized dataset + temporary access key (least friction). Alternative: VPC peering for sandbox cluster; we'll need CIDR and peering window.
- IAM: create a service account with s3:GetObject and limited IAM for logs.
- Test dataset format: CSV with columns [request_id, text, label_intent, label_slots]; sample size 10k.
- Traffic replay: gzip'ed ndjson with timestamps for a 30-min sample.

I'll own the baseline runs and tuning. Action items for Acme: share S3 path or schedule peering by 10/22. I've attached an access checklist (redwood-access-checklist.xlsx) with the exact fields we need.

We can also add a lightweight telemetry dashboard during the POC to show latency and error rates in near real-time. Happy to demo.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-access-checklist.xlsx
